learner_starting_state: Can trace an offline API client and select text-analysis capabilities but may conflate speech recognition, synthesis, and multimodal model interaction.
learner_ending_state: Can select recognition, synthesis, or a deployed multimodal spoken-prompt flow and trace audio file plus result/cancellation handling.
mastery_gate: Score 12 of 12 on primary and fresh-transfer forms, demonstrate recognition, synthesis, multimodal spoken prompts, and two client-flow safeguards per form, then explain one choice without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: AI-901 scope and Azure Speech capabilities trace to current official Microsoft sources; scenarios, reasons, and gates are course-authored.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify SDK packages, API shapes, endpoints, authentication, supported languages/voices/formats, regions, quotas, pricing, and preview status before live use.

notes: Offline scenario package; captures or plays no real audio and calls no service.
